% tab_multichip, note. Generated by paper-v4/tools/make_tables.py; do not edit.
All runs use 118 residues on a slice with eight chips visible. The scripts compute throughput as the queries per call divided by the unrounded steady-state call. We give no throughput for the rows that time \texttt{predict} or for the external ensemble, which computes one query. Chips with data counts the chips with nonzero HBM in use. Not kept marks a value that is missing from the summary. For automatic partitioning, each run kept one value of HBM in use, 463~MB, and the summary does not say whether 463~MB is the mean over the eight chips or the HBM in use on chip~0 alone. MB is 1,000,000 bytes. Rows differ in script, so ratios between rows are not speedups. \emph{Alphabet} and \emph{fixed} are the repeated-alphabet and fixed sequences. Times keep the decimals that the scripts round to, including trailing zeros.
